To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

three different crystal forms of the Tet-receptor/operator complex were obtained, and the crystal structures of the P21 and P6122 crystal forms were determined by molecular replacement using a search model of the TetR molecule of the complex containing tetracycline.
the crystal structure of a Tet-repressor/operator-complex was solved by molecular replacement.
the crystal structure of a Tet-repressor-operator complex was determined by X-ray diffraction to a resolution of 1.9 Å.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the crystallization and preliminary Xray analysis of the TetR repressor in complex with a 17 bp operator.
the structural characterization of the Tet-repressors/operator complexes of the class D Tet-repressors.
the structural characterization of a complex of a Tet-repressor class D with the 17 bp operator.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the three crystal forms of the TetR class D/operator complex were obtained by hanging drop vapor diffusion methods using PEG as precipitant and that they are isomorphous.
the three crystal forms represent the same repressor-operator complex in different crystal environments.
the crystal forms are not isomorphous, and that the crystals are not isomophous to the crystals of the complex of the repressor with tetracyline, although they are isomorphous to each other.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the crystal structure of a repressor protein complexed to a DNA operator sequence is a very rare example of a structure of an entire gene-regulatory system.
the repressor-operator complex crystallizes readily in different crystal forms and that these crystals are suitable for high-resolution structure determination.
the crystallization conditions of the TetR class D protein are very sensitive and that the protein can form several crystal forms with very similar crystallization conditions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the crystallization conditions are very similar to those used for the crystal form containing the antibiotic tetracycline.
the repressor-operator complex can crystallize in different crystal forms with different crystal habits, which may be due to different conformations of the repressor molecule in the crystals.
it is possible to obtain crystals of a protein in complex with a ligand by using a precipitant that is not compatible with the protein.
